key_capabilities_post_pr140: R-LIVE V2 registry-driven 13-asset surface: AAPL, NVDA, AMZN, GOOGL, TSLA, AVGO, NFLX, AMD, DELL, SNAP, INTC, MSFT, META
R-LIVE public API (6 read-only routes): GET /api/v1.1/radar/r-live/assets, /r-live/current, /r-live/history/ranges, /r-live/{uid}, /r-live/{uid}/history, /r-live/{uid}/history/ranges
/radar redirects to /radar/r-live (R-LIVE is default Radar domain)
Freshness distinction: market/pool activity age (300s TWAP gate), oracle age (Chainlink USDG/USD), block age, effective evidence timestamp, FINCO collection timestamp (collected_at)
collected_at (FINCO collection timestamp) is structurally separate from effective_evidence_at (on-chain observation time)
1h/24h range semantics: historical, collection-timestamp-selected, >= 2 points required, no interpolation
STALE last-available UX: explicitly HISTORICAL, badge remains STALE, last canonical value shown for UX continuity
Landing batch architecture: 1 current request + 1 range request, not 16 individual requests
SCAN_COMPLETE = NO: wide admission scan environment-blocked (egress policy blocked api.robinhood.com and rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com); no authority standards weakened
300-second TWAP freshness gate; STALE != UNAVAILABLE != empty
B2.3 concurrent duplicate delivery fix (PR #135): lock-safe, exactly one event
R-LIVE multi-asset collector: no-arg collects all 13 approved assets serially; STALE/UNAVAILABLE per-asset are canonical market states, not process failures
Staging collector config contract: ROBINHOOD_RPC_URL + RADAR_BNB_INTELLIGENCE_DB_PATH; staging/production ledgers must be separate

operational_config_requirements.ROBINHOOD_RPC_URL: Required for both web current-read and the collector. Never committed to Git. Missing → RPC_NOT_CONFIGURED.
operational_config_requirements.RADAR_BNB_INTELLIGENCE_DB_PATH: Shared durable B1.3 history ledger. Web and collector must use the identical path. Staging and production must be different files.
operational_config_requirements.FINCO_RUN_CERT_SIGNING_KEY: Required for Signed Run Certificate issuance. Ed25519 seed, base64. Missing → SigningKeyUnavailable.
operational_config_requirements.FINCO_SESSION_TOKEN: Required for MCP V1. Server-configured signed session token.
